title: What Are the Effects of Fibrinogen Concentrate Administration on Biological Parameters
brief_summary: the fibrinogen concentrate are given since 50 years with the dose of 2g for a afibrinogenemia. But this dose has been fixed 40 years ago and from now nobody discuss this quantity. Through this retrospective study the investigators tried to explore the evolution of blood test after a prescription of fibrinogen concentrate
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patient who received fibrinogen concentrate

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
study_population: all patient who received fibrinogen concentrate
